title: Vegan Italian Pasta Bake
description: A flavorful and satisfying vegan pasta bake that combines the best of Italian and vibrant flavors. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to release their juices.
Stir in marinara sauce and dried basil. Bring to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomato sauce mixture, and vegan mozzarella cheese. Mix well.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional vegan mozzarella cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
